notes.title: Lust Storm - Current Progress & Small Preview
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello folks![/b]
[/p][p][/p][p]It’s been over three months since we made our Steam page public and more than a month since we released the demo, so we thought it was a good time to share a general update on the rest of the game.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45532298/bd3d4b46e2eeaf12639519eb6af5a7693b68792f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As you can see in the graph above, we’re steadily moving toward the release build. There have been some backwards steps with fixes and polishing, but overall, everything is on track and progressing well.[/p][p][/p][p]While the Steam page still says [i]Coming Soon[/i] for the release date, we’re aiming to launch the full game in about 1 to 2 months. If you haven’t played the demo yet, we definitely recommend giving it a try and if you’d like to share feedback, we’d be really happy to hear it.[/p][p][/p][p]On the technical side, we’ve made several improvements, especially around dialogue and immersion, based on the feedback we’ve received. We don't just want to build the game around +18 content, we’re aiming for a slowburn narrative where the story gradually deepens and characters evolve in meaningful ways.
[/p][p]Below, we’re sharing a few renders from the game and we hope you enjoy them!
I don’t want to spoil too much just yet... But you’ll be learning more very soon.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45532298/4f9be8b86dea1c24008b7acad1ec523552d1564d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45532298/be028494f82ab91bd1bc1ab9954cc653dc656138.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45532298/caeaddaa4c1c7419b50ab4413483b8e9b1f0fe82.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45532298/b0d25057f158255d2c7c73705a969da2023e993f.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Major Localization Update: 6 New Languages + Dialogue & Voice Revisions
notes.notes:
[p]We’ve just released a major update to our [b]previously released demo[/b], focusing on localization and overall polish!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45532298/6756c13fb30810882c44e7bde3a2dc0d5056d76b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]🔹 First, we’ve revised a large part of the game’s dialogue and voice timing to improve clarity, emotional impact, and overall flow. 

🔹 Second, we’ve officially added support for [b]six new languages[/b] beyond English:[/p][list][*][p]Spanish[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Traditional Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]German[/p][/*][*][p]Russian
[/p][/*][/list][p]Our goal is to make the game more accessible to players around the world, and we’d love to hear what you think.

If you're playing in one of the newly supported languages and notice any awkward phrasing, technical bugs, or areas we could improve — your feedback would be incredibly helpful.
[/p][p]We're continuing to improve based on your input, so thank you for being part of the journey![/p]

notes.title: Lust Storm Demo is now available!
notes.notes:
Episode 1 is now available as a free demo on Steam! It offers around 50–60 minutes of gameplay. Jump in, experience the beginning of our story, and let us know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45532298/26bb4956f05ff4be7465eb9d0bbd2cffee3288be.jpg[/img]

You can share your thoughts by leaving a comment on our Community page, writing a review on the demo or messaging us directly by joining our Discord. We'd love to hear from you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45532298/3ccdc725e8f46505896f9f3eb11b47bc1d7bd8f9.jpg[/img]

If you enjoy it, don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist, it really helps us out.

Thank you for your support. 

See you soon!

notes.title: Steam Demo Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We’re excited to let you know that we’ve just submitted our demo to Steam for review! Once it’s approved, we’ll release it immediately—so stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45532298/ff638a2818c7222a37afa5e79f429795d1f359b5.jpg[/img]

The purpose of this demo is simple: we want to give you a clear idea of what to expect from the full game. Whether you love it or not, we believe it’s important to be transparent and give you the chance to experience a slice of the game before making any decisions.

From now on, we’ll be more active with updates and announcements, sharing behind-the-scenes insights and keeping you informed about our development progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45532298/7367b3bb068d0a8211f0f68c7d184c9cdf095b15.jpg[/img]

Thank you all for your support—it truly means a lot to us!

Volcano Games
